items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Joe said, 'I'm gonna take the first set down. After I take the first set down, you got it. I'm gone.'

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

The first time I was with him out there in Akron, I played a book. Went out to the dance with them (inaudible) -- got dressed, went out to the dance with him and Joe said, 'I'm gonna take the first set down. After I take the first set down, you got it. I'm gone.'
So now they don't play -- I think that he's betting that I'm not gonna play in the second set that I'm gonna open up with.
